question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Meta)

calls.reasoning: Meta reports Q3 2026 on Oct 28. Consensus is about $6.74-6.77 and excludes legal charges. Meta disclosed it will accrue about $10B of legal expense in Q3 for the 29-state youth settlement. At about 2.55-2.58B shares and a 15-17% tax rate, that cuts EPS by about $3.3-3.9, so GAAP diluted EPS should be about $3.0-3.6, well below 5.345. Q2 2026 GAAP EPS of $6.18 included $2.4B of legal charges and missed consensus by about $1, so GAAP is the likeliest reported figure. My estimate is about 75% GAAP, but declared mass is capped at 0.5. The blank resolution criteria leave a material chance that an adjusted figure (about $6.6-7.3, beat-prone) is used instead. Markets: none found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi.

- Status quo: Meta reports GAAP only, and its headline diluted EPS will include the accrual unless the settlement accounting changes.

- Event window: the first EPS report after Sept 2026, i.e., the Oct 28, 2026 release. As of Oct 11 the event has not yet occurred.
